title: CastFlow: Learning Role-Specialized Agentic Workflows for Time Series Forecasting

claim.summary: CastFlow separates frozen planning/reflection from a trainable forecasting reasoner, combining diagnostic tools, retrieved successful strategies and an ensemble forecast anchor.

modules.name: Statistical and spectral temporal profiling
modules.scope_reason: Distribution statistics, spectral entropy and temporal diagnostics describe observed data independently of a target forecast.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; IV.B.2 Statistical and Spectral Profiler

modules.name: Validated forecast-strategy memory and workflow
modules.scope_reason: Strategies are selected by horizon MSE and drive baseline selection, diagnostic scheduling and forecast refinement.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; IV.C Memory and workflow

modules.name: Specialized evidence-guided forecast LLM
modules.scope_reason: Only the forecasting language module receives SFT/GRPO; planner and reflection models are frozen.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; IV.D Role-Specialized Reasoning Architecture
